feeds.title: Pixel Art Shop
feeds.description: Get the latest news and art project updates from the Pixel Art Shop. Check out pop culture in Perler beads. My name is Kyle McCoy. Once upon a time, I loved making pixel art but was tired of staring at a computer screen all day. Solution: Perler Beads! Each bead is placed individually then carefully fused together into a solid, vibrant piece that is mounted to high-quality canvas making this the perfect craft for creating handmade 3D pixel artwork.
